title: HyperFix Brick
description: The more expansive version of the HyperFix SMP modpack.
body:
This modpack is intended as a much more expansive version of the HyperFix Lightweight pack, for players of the HyperFix SMP. This version includes a range of performance optimization mods, utilities including a zoom function and game replay, as well as several mods meant for use with the server, such as Simple Voice Chat, Status, and Armor Poser.

HyperFix Brick is meant as a semi-vanilla equivalent of a kitchen sink modpack, intended to maximize QoL changes while adhering to an approximation of vanilla gameplay.
